trip.title: Vietnam 2026
trip.subtitle: Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Da Nang, Hoi An, Ho Chi Minh City

stays.name: Old Quarter Boutique Hotel
stays.notes: Check-in after 14:00 and check-out before 12:00. Airport transfer can be arranged.

stays.name: Emerald Bay Cruise
stays.address: Tuan Chau Marina, Ha Long, Vietnam
stays.notes: Overnight cruise. Check-in at Tuan Chau Marina before departure.

stays.name: Han River Riverside Hotel
stays.address: Hai Chau District, Da Nang, Vietnam
stays.notes: Central location near the Han River and Dragon Bridge.

stays.name: Hoi An Heritage Villa
stays.notes: Quiet property within cycling distance of the Old Town.

stays.name: District 1 City Hotel
stays.address: District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
stays.notes: Central District 1 location near major attractions and restaurants.

days.title: Flying to Vietnam
days.summary: Begin the journey to Vietnam with an overnight flight.

items.title: Airport check-in
items.description: Arrive at the airport for international check-in and security. Keep your passport and travel documents in your cabin baggage.

items.title: Flight to Hanoi
items.description: Depart for Hanoi on an overnight international flight.

days.title: Welcome to Hanoi
days.summary: Arrive in Vietnam and explore Hanoi's atmospheric Old Quarter.

items.title: Arrive in Hanoi
items.description: Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport and complete immigration and baggage collection.

items.title: Transfer to Hanoi
items.description: Travel from Noi Bai Airport to the city centre and leave luggage at the hotel.

items.title: Vietnamese breakfast
items.description: Start the trip with a traditional bowl of pho and Vietnamese coffee.

items.title: Hotel check-in
items.description: Check into the hotel and take some time to rest after the flight.

items.title: Hoan Kiem Lake
items.description: Walk around Hoan Kiem Lake and visit Ngoc Son Temple.

items.title: Hanoi Old Quarter
items.description: Explore the narrow streets, local shops and historic architecture of the Old Quarter.

items.title: Street food dinner
items.description: Try Vietnamese street food including bun cha, spring rolls and local desserts.

days.title: Historic Hanoi
days.summary: Discover Hanoi's temples, museums and traditional neighbourhoods.

items.title: Temple of Literature
items.description: Visit the Temple of Literature, one of Hanoi's most important historic and cultural sites.

items.title: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum area
items.description: Explore the Ba Dinh Square area and surrounding historic landmarks.

items.title: Lunch in Hanoi
items.description: Enjoy a traditional Vietnamese lunch in the city centre.

items.title: Train Street
items.description: Visit Hanoi's famous railway neighbourhood from a designated safe viewing area.

items.title: French Quarter
items.description: Walk through Hanoi's French Quarter and admire its colonial-era architecture.

items.title: Water puppet show
items.description: Watch a traditional Vietnamese water puppet performance.

items.title: Hanoi night market
items.description: Explore the evening streets and markets around the Old Quarter.

days.title: Journey to Ha Long Bay
days.summary: Leave Hanoi and board an overnight cruise through Ha Long Bay.

items.title: Depart Hanoi
items.description: Travel by shuttle from Hanoi to Tuan Chau Marina.

items.title: Board the cruise
items.description: Complete cruise check-in, board the ship and have lunch while sailing into Ha Long Bay.

items.title: Kayaking
items.description: Explore the limestone karsts and calm waters of the bay by kayak.

items.title: Sunset on the bay
items.description: Relax on deck and watch the sunset over the limestone islands.

items.title: Cruise dinner
items.description: Enjoy a multi-course Vietnamese dinner onboard.

items.title: Evening on the cruise
items.description: Relax on deck, enjoy the night scenery or take part in onboard activities.

days.title: Ha Long Bay to Da Nang
days.summary: Wake up on the bay, return to land and fly south to Da Nang.

items.title: Sunrise on Ha Long Bay
items.description: Wake early for sunrise and enjoy the quiet waters of the bay.

items.title: Breakfast on board
items.description: Enjoy breakfast while the cruise returns towards the marina.

items.title: Cruise checkout
items.description: Disembark at Tuan Chau Marina and transfer towards the airport.

items.title: Flight to Da Nang
items.description: Fly from northern Vietnam to Da Nang in central Vietnam.

items.title: Hotel check-in
items.description: Check into the Da Nang hotel and settle in.

items.title: My Khe Beach
items.description: Take an evening walk along My Khe Beach.

items.title: Seafood dinner
items.description: Enjoy fresh Vietnamese seafood near the beach.

days.title: Ba Na Hills
days.summary: Spend the day in the mountains at Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge.

items.title: Depart for Ba Na Hills
items.description: Travel from Da Nang into the Ba Na Hills mountain area.

items.title: Golden Bridge
items.description: Visit the famous Golden Bridge and enjoy panoramic mountain views.

items.title: Ba Na Hills
items.description: Explore the mountain resort, gardens and attractions.

items.title: Lunch
items.description: Have lunch at Ba Na Hills.

items.title: Return to Da Nang
items.description: Return to Da Nang and rest at the hotel.

items.title: Dragon Bridge
items.description: Visit Dragon Bridge and explore the Han River waterfront.

items.title: Dinner by the Han River
items.description: Enjoy dinner overlooking the river.

days.title: Marble Mountains and Son Tra
days.summary: Explore Da Nang's temples, caves and coastal viewpoints.

items.title: Marble Mountains
items.description: Explore the caves, pagodas and viewpoints of the Marble Mountains.

items.title: Vietnamese lunch
items.description: Stop for a local lunch in Da Nang.

items.title: Son Tra Peninsula
items.description: Drive around the Son Tra Peninsula and enjoy views of the coast.

items.title: Linh Ung Pagoda
items.description: Visit Linh Ung Pagoda and see the large Lady Buddha statue overlooking the sea.

items.title: My Khe sunset
items.description: Relax at My Khe Beach and enjoy sunset.

items.title: Da Nang dinner
items.description: Enjoy a final dinner in Da Nang.

days.title: Da Nang to Hoi An
days.summary: Travel south to Hoi An and explore the ancient town after dark.

items.title: Check out of Da Nang hotel
items.description: Check out and travel towards Hoi An.

items.title: Hoi An arrival
items.description: Arrive in Hoi An and leave luggage at the hotel.

items.title: Hoi An lunch
items.description: Try local specialties such as cao lau, white rose dumplings or banh mi.

items.title: Hotel check-in
items.description: Check into the Hoi An villa and relax.

items.title: Japanese Covered Bridge
items.description: Explore Hoi An's historic centre and visit the Japanese Covered Bridge.

items.title: Hoi An lantern streets
items.description: Explore the lantern-lit streets of the Old Town after sunset.

items.title: Riverside dinner
items.description: Have dinner along the Thu Bon River.

days.title: Countryside and Beach
days.summary: Explore Hoi An's countryside before relaxing at An Bang Beach.

items.title: Cycling through the countryside
items.description: Cycle through rice fields and small villages surrounding Hoi An.

items.title: Tra Que Vegetable Village
items.description: Visit Tra Que village and learn about traditional local farming.

items.title: Cooking lunch
items.description: Take part in a Vietnamese cooking experience and enjoy the meal afterwards.

items.title: An Bang Beach
items.description: Relax at An Bang Beach and enjoy a slower afternoon.

items.title: Old Town evening
items.description: Return to the Old Town for shopping and lantern-lit streets.

items.title: Hoi An dinner
items.description: Enjoy a final dinner in Hoi An.

days.title: Fly to Ho Chi Minh City
days.summary: Leave central Vietnam and continue south to Ho Chi Minh City.

items.title: Check out of Hoi An
items.description: Check out and transfer to Da Nang International Airport.

items.title: Flight to Ho Chi Minh City
items.description: Fly from Da Nang to Ho Chi Minh City.

items.title: Hotel check-in
items.description: Check into the District 1 hotel and settle in.

items.title: Ben Thanh Market
items.description: Explore one of Ho Chi Minh City's best-known markets.

items.title: Nguyen Hue Walking Street
items.description: Walk along Nguyen Hue and experience the city's evening atmosphere.

items.title: Vietnamese dinner
items.description: Enjoy a modern Vietnamese dinner in District 1.

days.title: History and Saigon
days.summary: Discover Ho Chi Minh City's history and landmarks.

items.title: War Remnants Museum
items.description: Visit the War Remnants Museum and learn about the history of the Vietnam War.

items.title: Independence Palace
items.description: Explore the Independence Palace and its historic grounds.

items.title: Lunch in District 1
items.description: Enjoy pho, banh xeo or another Vietnamese specialty.

items.title: Saigon Central Post Office
items.description: Visit the historic Central Post Office and explore the surrounding French colonial district.

items.title: Notre-Dame Cathedral area
items.description: Explore the area surrounding Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon.

items.title: Saigon River
items.description: Take a relaxed walk near the Saigon River.

items.title: Rooftop dinner
items.description: Enjoy dinner with a view over the Ho Chi Minh City skyline.

days.title: Fly Home
days.summary: Enjoy breakfast, check out and head to the airport.

items.title: Vietnamese breakfast
items.description: Have a final Vietnamese breakfast and coffee.

items.title: Hotel checkout
items.description: Check out of the hotel and collect your luggage.

items.title: Airport transfer
items.description: Transfer from District 1 to Tan Son Nhat International Airport.

items.title: Flight home
items.description: Depart Ho Chi Minh City for the return journey home.
